Testing Steps: 1. Double-click 'Wealthfire Preview.cmd'. 2. Wait for the browser to open http://127.0.0.1:5180/ in a fresh Edge InPrivate window. 3. Keep the 'Wealthfire preview server' window open while testing.
Expected Result: The Wealthfire Sign in screen shows. Closing the server window stops the preview.

Test Objective: Start again from a clean state
Testing Steps: Close the InPrivate window and open a new one at http://127.0.0.1:5180/ (or Settings > Delete all data).
Expected Result: Sign in screen shows with no saved data.

Test Objective: Skip onboarding to test other sections
Testing Steps: Open http://127.0.0.1:5180/<section>?preview=demo in a new InPrivate window, e.g. /profile, /expenses, /fire, /settings.
Expected Result: The demo user opens straight on that section with onboarding already done (local preview only).

Test Objective: Sign in with a mobile number
Testing Steps: 1. Keep 'Mobile number' selected. 2. Type 98765 43210. 3. Click Send OTP.
Expected Result: OTP screen shows 'We sent a code to +91 ******3210' and a yellow Demo banner with a 6-digit code.

Testing Steps: Type 5876543210 (starts with 5) and click outside the field.
Expected Result: Error 'Enter a valid 10-digit mobile number.' Send OTP stays disabled.

Testing Steps: Choose Email, type you@example.com, click Send OTP.
Expected Result: OTP screen shows the masked email and a Demo code.

Testing Steps: Type the code from the Demo banner and click Verify.
Expected Result: Your details screen shows.

Testing Steps: Type 000000 (or any wrong code) and click Verify. Repeat 5 times.
Expected Result: 'Wrong code. N tries left.' After 5 wrong tries the code stops working and you must send a new one.

Testing Steps: Right after sending, look at the Resend button.
Expected Result: It shows 'Resend in 0:SS' counting down and is enabled after 30 seconds.

Testing Steps: First name Nitish, Last name Sana, PAN ABCPS1234F, Aadhaar 234123412346, tick the consent box, click Continue.
Expected Result: Verify Aadhaar screen shows with 'Enter the OTP sent to the mobile linked with Aadhaar XXXX XXXX 2346.'

Testing Steps: Type PAN ABCCS1234F.
Expected Result: Message 'This looks like a non-individual PAN. Use your personal PAN.' Continue stays disabled.

Testing Steps: Type Aadhaar 234123412347.
Expected Result: Message 'Enter a valid 12-digit Aadhaar number.'

Testing Steps: Type last name Kumar with PAN ABCPS1234F.
Expected Result: Soft warning that the PAN's 5th letter usually matches your last name. Continue still allowed.

Testing Steps: Type the Demo code and click Verify Aadhaar.
Expected Result: Upload documents screen shows. No second Aadhaar OTP is asked for later in the flow.

Testing Steps: Restart, use Aadhaar 234123470000 in Your details, continue to Verify Aadhaar.
Expected Result: Message 'Your Aadhaar has no linked mobile...' and onboarding does not continue.

Testing Steps: Look at the Upload documents screen.
Expected Result: Exactly: 1. Your selfie (Take photo, Upload), 2. Aadhaar card (Upload), 3. PAN card (Upload). No demo text or reader options.

Test Objective: Take photo with permission and crop
Testing Steps: 1. Click Take photo on Your selfie. 2. Allow the browser camera prompt. 3. Click Capture. 4. Click Crop, drag and zoom, click Done. 5. Click Use photo.
Expected Result: A camera permission prompt appears first; live video shows; Retake / Crop / Use photo appear after capture; the cropped square photo shows in the selfie slot with Replace and Remove.

Testing Steps: Block the camera in the browser prompt, then click Take photo.
Expected Result: 'Allow camera access, or choose a file instead.' Upload still works.

Testing Steps: Upload a .gif or a file over 10 MB to the PAN slot.
Expected Result: 'Use a JPG, PNG or PDF under 10 MB.'

Test Objective: Same file in both card slots
Testing Steps: Upload the same image to Aadhaar card and PAN card.
Expected Result: 'You uploaded the same file for both cards. Upload your Aadhaar and PAN separately.'

Testing Steps: Upload a locked e-Aadhaar PDF to the Aadhaar slot and click Continue.
Expected Result: A 'PDF password' field appears. With the right password it reads; a wrong one shows 'That password didn't open the PDF. Try again.' The password is not saved.

Testing Steps: Use your real name in Your details, upload clear photos or PDFs of your own PAN and Aadhaar, click Continue.
Expected Result: 'Reading your documents... NN%' then Check numbers shows Match and 'Name matches' for both cards.

Testing Steps: Upload any non-card PDF or image (for example a bill) to the PAN slot.
Expected Result: 'This doesn't look like a PAN card. Upload your PAN card.' It is not accepted as a match.

Testing Steps: Upload one photo that shows two PAN cards.
Expected Result: 'Upload a photo with just one card.'

Testing Steps: Type your own name, upload another person's PAN card, click Use number from document.
Expected Result: 'The name on this card doesn't match the name you entered.' and 'We'll check this by hand.' Confirm ends as Under review, never Pre-verified.

Testing Steps: Open http://127.0.0.1:5180/?reader=demo&mode=match in a new InPrivate window, complete onboarding up to Check numbers, click Confirm.
Expected Result: 'Both numbers match your documents.' Done screen: 'Your documents match. A final KYC check confirms your account before you can invest.' Settings > Account shows 'Pre-verified - final KYC pending'.

Testing Steps: Open http://127.0.0.1:5180/?reader=demo&mode=misread in a new InPrivate window. At Check numbers click Upload again (or Use number from document on PAN), then Confirm.
Expected Result: Each card first shows Doesn't match; after the re-check it shows Match; Confirm ends Pre-verified.

Testing Steps: Open http://127.0.0.1:5180/?reader=demo&mode=different in a new InPrivate window. At Check numbers click Upload again twice, then Confirm.
Expected Result: 'We'll check this by hand.' Done screen shows the Under review text. Settings > Account shows Under review.

Testing Steps: Open http://127.0.0.1:5180/?reader=demo&mode=unreadable in a new InPrivate window. At Upload documents click Continue twice.
Expected Result: 'We couldn't read your card. Our team can check your documents by hand instead.' and a button 'Send my documents for a hand check'. Clicking it ends onboarding as Under review.

Test Objective: Aadhaar cannot be edited on Check numbers
Testing Steps: At Check numbers look at the Aadhaar row.
Expected Result: Label 'Verified number'. Only 'Upload again' is offered for Aadhaar (no Edit, no Use number from document).

Testing Steps: At Check numbers use Upload again 2 times on one card.
Expected Result: 'N re-checks left' counts down; after 2 the card shows 'No re-checks left for this card.'

Testing Steps: At Upload documents press F5 (reload).
Expected Result: Upload documents shows 'Enter your Aadhaar number again'. It must end in the verified last 4 digits. No new OTP is sent.

Test Objective: Tabs do not reset each other
Testing Steps: Open the app in two tabs of the same window. In tab 1 reach Check numbers. Look at tab 2.
Expected Result: Tab 2 shows 'Your onboarding moved on in another tab...' and does not send tab 1 back.

Testing Steps: After onboarding open Settings.
Expected Result: Account card shows masked contact, PAN as ABCPS****F, Aadhaar XXXX XXXX 2346 with 'OTP verified', and the account status.

Testing Steps: With an account that is Pre-verified or Under review, open Settings and click 'Approve final KYC (demo)'.
Expected Result: Status changes to Verified and the done text 'Your final KYC check is complete. Your account is verified.' This card never appears on the live site.

Testing Steps: With an Under review account click Reject, type a reason, confirm. Then click Redo documents.
Expected Result: Status 'Review rejected' with the reason; Redo documents goes back to Upload documents without a new OTP.

Testing Steps: Click Sign out.
Expected Result: Sign in screen shows. After signing in again, Net worth, Expenses and other data are still there.

Testing Steps: Click Download backup and open the JSON file.
Expected Result: Only the Aadhaar last 4 digits appear. No 12-digit Aadhaar number, no documents, no OTPs.

Testing Steps: Finish onboarding (any outcome) and click Go to Home.
Expected Result: Home shows the summary tiles, FIRE progress and FIRE types table.

Testing Steps: Open Profile when the profile name is empty.
Expected Result: Name shows 'Nitish Sana' from Your details.

Testing Steps: Open Risk and answer the 6 questions.
Expected Result: A score of 0-100 and a risk profile show.

Testing Steps: Open Net worth, add an asset and a loan.
Expected Result: Net worth and asset mix update.

Testing Steps: Open Expenses, add a spend by hand and upload a CSV statement.
Expected Result: Spends appear with categories; Gmail card is present.

Testing Steps: Open FIRE plan and move the retire-age slider.
Expected Result: FIRE number, SIP needed and the FIRE types comparison update.

Testing Steps: Open Portfolio.
Expected Result: Fund category mix and SIP split show.

Testing Steps: Open Buckets.
Expected Result: Spend, Refill and Grow buckets with move tips show.

Testing Steps: Open Progress and add a check-in.
Expected Result: The check-in appears in the history table.

Testing Steps: Open Connect.
Expected Result: Bank, CAS, broker placeholders and the Gmail card show.

Testing Steps: Open Settings, change Inflation, then click Reset to defaults.
Expected Result: Values change and reset.
